Title: Portal Infrastructure Foundation
Description: Deploy production-grade infrastructure foundation for NexusOne portal including Kubernetes cluster for portal services, databases for portal metadata (PostgreSQL, Redis), CI/CD pipeline, and environment management. NOTE: This does NOT include Trino, Airflow, DataHub, Ranger - those already exist in production.
Acceptance Criteria: Kubernetes cluster for portal operational with 99.9% uptime; PostgreSQL and Redis for portal metadata deployed with HA; CI/CD pipeline executing automated tests and deployments for portal services; Environment management for dev/stage/prod configured

Title: Kubernetes Cluster for Portal
Description: Deploy a production-grade Kubernetes cluster for NexusOne portal services with auto-scaling, monitoring, and high availability configuration.
Acceptance Criteria: Kubernetes cluster for portal deployed in production region with multi-AZ HA; Network policies and ingress configured; Auto-scaling enabled for portal pods; Monitoring agents installed

Title: Deploy Production Kubernetes Cluster for Portal
Description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want a production-grade Kubernetes cluster deployed for the NexusOne portal, so that we have a resilient, scalable platform for portal services (NOT data tools).
Acceptance Criteria: 3-node Kubernetes cluster deployed for portal services; Multi-AZ configuration for high availability; Network policies configured for portal pod-to-pod communication; StorageClass configured for persistent volumes; Ingress controller deployed; Auto-scaling enabled for portal services; Monitoring agents installed; 99.9% uptime SLA achievable

Title: Configure Portal Namespace Strategy
Description: As a Platform Engineer, I want namespaces for portal environments, so that we have clear resource isolation for portal services.
Acceptance Criteria: Namespaces created: nexusone-portal-prod, nexusone-portal-stage, nexusone-portal-dev; Resource quotas defined per namespace; Network policies enforce namespace isolation; Service accounts with least-privilege access; RBAC roles configured
Dependencies: Deploy Production Kubernetes Cluster for Portal

Title: Portal Database Infrastructure
Description: Deploy PostgreSQL for portal metadata storage and Redis for portal caching and sessions. NOTE: These are for PORTAL application data (user sessions, preferences, query history), NOT for Trino/Airflow/DataHub (those already have their own databases).
Acceptance Criteria: PostgreSQL 15+ for portal metadata deployed with streaming replication; Redis 7+ for portal cache deployed with persistence; Connection pooling configured; Automated backups configured; Monitoring integrated

Title: Deploy PostgreSQL for Portal Metadata
Description: As a Backend Engineer, I want a PostgreSQL cluster for portal metadata storage, so that we have reliable storage for portal application data (user sessions, preferences, query history, etc.). NOTE: This is for PORTAL metadata, NOT for Trino/Airflow/DataHub.
Acceptance Criteria: PostgreSQL 15+ deployed with streaming replication; 2-node cluster: 1 primary, 1 replica; Connection pooling configured; Automated backups configured; SSL/TLS encryption enabled; Performance tuning applied
Dependencies: Deploy Production Kubernetes Cluster for Portal

Title: Deploy Redis for Portal Cache
Description: As a Backend Engineer, I want a Redis cluster for portal caching and sessions, so that we have fast caching for the portal application.
Acceptance Criteria: Redis 7+ cluster deployed; Persistence configured (AOF + RDB); Connection security (TLS, AUTH); Monitoring configured
Dependencies: Deploy Production Kubernetes Cluster for Portal

Title: CI/CD Pipeline for Portal
Description: Implement automated build and deployment pipeline for portal services with testing, vulnerability scanning, and GitOps-based deployment.
Acceptance Criteria: GitHub Actions workflows configured for portal services; Automated testing on every PR; Container images built, scanned, and pushed; GitOps deployment with ArgoCD; Environment promotion workflow operational; Automated rollback on failure

Title: Implement CI Pipeline for Portal
Description: As a Developer, I want an automated CI pipeline for portal services, so that every commit is validated and deployable.
Acceptance Criteria: GitHub Actions workflows configured; Automated testing on every PR (unit, integration, e2e); Container images built and tagged for portal services; Images scanned for vulnerabilities; Images pushed to container registry; Build times under 10 minutes

Title: Implement CD Pipeline for Portal
Description: As a DevOps Engineer, I want an automated deployment pipeline for portal, so that validated builds are deployed safely.
Acceptance Criteria: GitOps deployment strategy implemented; Environment promotion workflow: dev → stage → prod; Manual approval gates for production; Automated rollback on deployment failure; Deployment notifications
